import json
import unittest
from stream_json import decode_prefix

class PrefixDecoding(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nested_value_and_unicode_end_index(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('{"label":"湾","items":[{"x":1}]}  NEXT'),
                         ({'label': '湾', 'items': [{'x': 1}]}, '  NEXT'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('[1,{"s":"}"}]TAIL'), ([1, {'s': '}'}], 'TAIL'))

    def test_scalars_and_concatenated_documents(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('"a}b"TAIL'), ('a}b', 'TAIL'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('3.5e2 rest'), (350.0, ' rest'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('truefalse'), (True, 'false'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('null\nnext'), (None, '\nnext'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('{}[]'), ({}, '[]'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('[]'), ([], ''))

    def test_invalid_start(self):
        for text in ['', 'oops', '{"x":}', '[1,']:
            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(json.JSONDecodeError):
                decode_prefix(text)

    def test_numeric_prefix_can_end_before_exponent_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('1eTAIL'), (1, 'eTAIL'))
        self.assertEqual(decode_prefix('01rest'), (0, '1rest'))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import json

def decode_prefix(text):
    value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(text)
    return value, text[end:]
